arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-pr52-merge.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
echo "PR52_LIVE_REBASE_START"
git clone -q --branch fix/codex-ignored-scope-audit-20261031 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/project"
cd "$tmp/project"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = aff5624746e981c47bab16facb9ddc6cde371672
git fetch -q origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = 945549620cc63f6ffc4c21db4778450064f137ec
echo "PR52_EXACT_REVISIONS=PASS"
git -c user.name="REA authorized integration" -c user.email="rea-merge@example.invalid" -c commit.gpgsign=false merge --no-ff -m "Merge current main into PR52 security fix" origin/main
echo "PR52_LOCAL_MERGE=PASS"
git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
python3 -m unittest discover -s codex/tests -p 'test_*.py' -q
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -q
echo "PR52_MERGED_REGRESSIONS=PASS"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
echo "PR52_NEW_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "PR52_DRY_PUSH_CHECK"
if git push --dry-run --quiet origin HEAD:refs/heads/fix/codex-ignored-scope-audit-20261031 >"$tmp/drypush.log" 2>&1; then
  echo "PR52_GIT_PUSH_AUTHORIZED=YES"
else
  echo "PR52_GIT_PUSH_AUTHORIZED=NO"
  echo "PR52_WRITE_NOT_PERFORMED"
  exit 55
fi
test "$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/fix/codex-ignored-scope-audit-20261031 | cut -f1)" = aff5624746e981c47bab16facb9ddc6cde371672
git push --quiet origin HEAD:refs/heads/fix/codex-ignored-scope-audit-20261031 >"$tmp/push.log" 2>&1
echo "PR52_BRANCH_UPDATED=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "PR52_REA_COMPLETE"
